summary: Claude for Open Source grants eligible maintainers and contributors a complimentary Claude Ultra subscription (named Max 20x before 2026-10-31) for six months. Capped at 10,000 approved recipients, rolling review until the cap is reached or the application period closes. Eligibility tracks: maintainers (500+ dependent repos, 100+ dependent packages, or 200k+ monthly downloads), core contributors on recognized foundation/language projects, active contributors (100+ merged PRs on others' repos in 12 months), community builders (20+ unique external merged-PR contributors in 12 months), critical infrastructure (OpenSSF criticality score >=0.4), plus a discretionary ecosystem-impact track. General requirements: natural person, GitHub account at least two years old and in good standing, public OSS activity in the last 90 days, and at least one OSI-approved-licensed project. Applicants must be at least 18 or their jurisdiction's age of majority, whichever is greater; be legal residents where Claude.ai is offered and not subject to US export/sanctions restrictions; and not be Anthropic/affiliate employees, contractors, agents, or their immediate family/household members. Approval is discretionary, not guaranteed by meeting a metric. Accepting the subscription permits Anthropic to identify you publicly as a recipient by name, GitHub username and associated open source projects; separate co-marketing activities are voluntary. The complimentary base subscription can still incur standard paid overage charges. Standard paid Ultra help lists $200/month in separately claimable API credits, but neither the OSS page nor its terms establishes whether the complimentary grant qualifies. API-benefit inclusion is unresolved, not promised or categorically excluded; check Settings → Billing or obtain provider confirmation.
claim_steps: Check the eligibility tracks and all general requirements at claude.com/contact-sales/claude-for-oss and anthropic.com/claude-for-oss-terms, including age, legal residence, sanctions and Anthropic-affiliate exclusions.
Apply at claude.com/open-source-max — sign in with your GitHub account, add email, planned usage, and a <=500-word qualification statement.
If approved, an activation link is emailed to your GitHub account email; activate within 90 days.
The base subscription runs six consecutive months; overages may be billed. An existing paid plan pauses and resumes afterward unless cancelled.
Before counting on API credits, check Settings → Billing for the complimentary plan or ask Anthropic to confirm its eligibility; standard paid Max terms alone do not prove this benefit applies.
Before accepting, note that the subscription grants Anthropic permission to identify you publicly by name, GitHub username and associated OSS projects. Separate co-marketing activities are optional.

social_proof.text: Thank you for everything you ship. 6 months of Claude Ultra on us. Open-source contributors keep the ecosystem running. The Claude for Open Source Program is our way of saying thank you for all your hard work, with 6 months of free Claude Ultra.

social_proof.title: Claude for Open Source Terms and Conditions | Anthropic
social_proof.text: The Program provides eligible open-source software maintainers and contributors with a complimentary subscription to Claude Ultra for a period of six months ... The Program is limited to 10,000 approved recipients unless this cap is increased by Anthropic.

social_proof.title: OSS program age and residence eligibility
social_proof.text: Be at least 18 years of age or the age of majority in their jurisdiction, whichever is greater; Be a legal resident of a country, region, or territory where Anthropic offers Claude.ai access and not be a person or entity subject to restrictions under U.S. export control or sanctions laws;

social_proof.title: OSS program affiliate exclusions
social_proof.text: Not be an employee, contractor, or agent of Anthropic or its affiliates, or an immediate family member or household member of such person.

social_proof.title: OSS program paid overage terms
social_proof.text: During the Benefit Period, you will not be charged for the base Claude Ultra subscription, but you may be charged for overages in accordance with Anthropic’s standard overage pricing.

social_proof.title: OSS program §5 — public identification and optional co-marketing
social_proof.text: By accepting a Program subscription, you grant Anthropic permission to identify you publicly as a Program recipient, including by referencing your name, GitHub username, and associated open source project(s). Anthropic may also invite you to participate in optional co-marketing activities, but your participation in any such activities is voluntary.
